description: The line plot illustrates the evaluation of different transformer models based on the ratio of parameters to the number of parameters, measured in percentage. The x-axis is labeled "Ratio of Parameters (%)" and is on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL" and is on a linear scale ranging from 11.5 to 14.0. The plot includes four lines representing different models: "Transformer" is depicted with a dashed red line, "Only MoHD FFN" with a solid grey line, "Only MoHD ATTN" with a solid blue line, and "MoHD ATTN + MLP" with a solid blue line with a diamond marker. The "Transformer" line remains relatively flat across the x-axis, indicating a stable evaluation PPL. The "Only MoHD FFN" line shows a slight increase in PPL as the parameter ratio increases. The "Only MoHD ATTN" line shows a more significant increase in PPL, particularly after the 75% parameter ratio mark. The "MoHD ATTN + MLP" line shows the highest increase in PPL, with a sharp rise after the 50% parameter ratio mark, peaking at the end of the x-axis.
